package app

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"os"
	"strings"
	"sync"
	"testing"
	"time"
)

type ownedConfigSnapshotObserverKey struct{}

func TestOwnedSharedSystemConfigMixed(t *testing.T) {
	ownedRemoteReachableInterleavings(t)
	data, e := os.ReadFile("../../testdata/plugin-shared-host-20261030/system-config/source/mixed-observations.json")
	if e != nil {
		t.Fatal(e)
	}
	var source struct {
		Groups map[string]struct {
			Observations map[string]json.RawMessage `json:"observations"`
		} `json:"groups"`
	}
	if e = json.Unmarshal(data, &source); e != nil {
		t.Fatal(e)
	}
	for _, name := range []string{"source-output", "delete-existing", "delete-recreate", "absent-insert"} {
		t.Run(name, func(t *testing.T) {
			dir := t.TempDir()
			markets := []string{}
			a, e := New(Options{DataDir: dir, PluginMarketsOverride: &markets})
			if e != nil {
				t.Fatal(e)
			}
			defer func() { a.Close() }()
			cookie := setupTestAdmin(t, a)
			p := installSharedSystemConfigFixture(t, a, cookie, sharedSystemConfigAll)
			initial, ui := "A", "C"
			if name == "source-output" {
				initial = "A => DiskInitial"
				ui = initial
			}
			if name == "absent-insert" {
				initial = ""
				ui = "A"
			}
			if initial != "" {
				raw, _ := json.Marshal([]string{initial})
				if _, e := systemConfigSet(t, p, string(raw)); e != nil {
					t.Fatal(e)
				}
			}
			selected, resume := make(chan struct{}), make(chan struct{})
			var once sync.Once
			observe := func() { once.Do(func() { close(selected); <-resume }) }
			requestBody, _ := json.Marshal(map[string]string{"text": ui})
			request := httptest.NewRequest("PUT", "/api/settings/recognition-words", strings.NewReader(string(requestBody)))
			request.Header.Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
			request.AddCookie(cookie)
			request = request.WithContext(context.WithValue(request.Context(), ownedConfigSnapshotObserverKey{}, observe))
			done := make(chan *httptest.ResponseRecorder, 1)
			go func() { w := httptest.NewRecorder(); a.Handler().ServeHTTP(w, request); done <- w }()
			select {
			case <-selected:
			case <-time.After(5 * time.Second):
				t.Fatal("UI did not reach actual SELECT")
			}
			synced := make(chan error, 1)
			go func() {
				var e error
				if name == "delete-existing" || name == "delete-recreate" {
					_, e = systemConfigSet(t, p, `null`)
				}
				if e == nil && name != "delete-existing" {
					v := `["B"]`
					if name == "source-output" {
						v = `["A => PluginNew"]`
					}
					_, e = systemConfigSet(t, p, v)
				}
				synced <- e
			}()
			select {
			case e := <-synced:
				if e != nil {
					close(resume)
					t.Fatal(e)
				}
			case <-time.After(5 * time.Second):
				close(resume)
				t.Fatal("sync setter blocked behind async SELECT")
			}
			close(resume)
			var response *httptest.ResponseRecorder
			select {
			case response = <-done:
			case <-time.After(5 * time.Second):
				t.Fatal("UI did not complete")
			}
			wantStatus := 200
			if name == "delete-existing" {
				wantStatus = 400
			}
			if response.Code != wantStatus {
				t.Fatal(response.Code, response.Body)
			}
			observation := source.Groups[name].Observations
			if name == "source-output" {
				assertSharedOracleJSON(t, systemConfigGet(t, p), observation["final_hot"])
				var rows [][]json.RawMessage
				if e = json.Unmarshal(observation["final_database"], &rows); e != nil {
					t.Fatal(e)
				}
				var raw string
				if e = json.Unmarshal(rows[0][0], &raw); e != nil {
					t.Fatal(e)
				}
				assertSystemConfigStored(t, a, []json.RawMessage{json.RawMessage(raw)})
				// Native metadata reads DB revision, but must not change source hot value.
				revision, _, e := a.recognitionWords(context.Background())
				if e != nil {
					t.Fatal(e)
				}
				assertSharedOracleJSON(t, systemConfigGet(t, p), observation["final_hot"])
				if e = a.saveRecognitionWords(context.Background(), revision, []string{"Native => Explicit"}); e != nil {
					t.Fatal(e)
				}
			} else {
				var want struct {
					Get  json.RawMessage     `json:"get"`
					Rows [][]json.RawMessage `json:"rows"`
				}
				if e = json.Unmarshal(observation["after_async"], &want); e != nil {
					t.Fatal(e)
				}
				assertSharedOracleJSON(t, systemConfigGet(t, p), want.Get)
				_, actual, e := a.readSharedSystemConfigRows(context.Background(), a.Store.DB)
				if e != nil {
					t.Fatal(e)
				}
				if len(actual) != len(want.Rows) {
					t.Fatal(actual, want.Rows)
				}
				for i, row := range actual {
					var id int64
					var raw string
					json.Unmarshal(want.Rows[i][0], &id)
					json.Unmarshal(want.Rows[i][2], &raw)
					if row.ID != id {
						t.Fatal(row.ID, id)
					}
					assertSharedOracleJSON(t, row.Value, json.RawMessage(raw))
				}
				if name == "absent-insert" {
					before := systemConfigGet(t, p)
					r := callTest(t, a.Handler(), "PUT", "/api/settings/recognition-words", `{"text":"D"}`, cookie, "")
					if r.Code != 400 || !strings.Contains(r.Body.String(), "SYSTEM_CONFIG_MULTIPLE_RESULTS") {
						t.Fatal(r.Code, r.Body)
					}
					revision, _, e := a.recognitionWords(context.Background())
					if e != nil {
						t.Fatal(e)
					}
					if e = a.saveRecognitionWords(context.Background(), revision, []string{"must-not-drop-row"}); e == nil {
						t.Fatal("native writer lost duplicate fact")
					}
					assertSharedOracleJSON(t, systemConfigGet(t, p), before)
				}
			}
			if e = a.Close(); e != nil {
				t.Fatal(e)
			}
			a, e = New(Options{DataDir: dir, PluginMarketsOverride: &markets})
			if e != nil {
				t.Fatal(e)
			}
			p = a.startOriginalPlugin(context.Background(), "OwnedSystemConfig")
			if p == nil {
				t.Fatal("cold actual worker absent")
			}
			switch name {
			case "source-output":
				assertSharedOracleJSON(t, systemConfigGet(t, p), json.RawMessage(`["Native => Explicit"]`))
			case "delete-existing":
				assertSharedOracleJSON(t, systemConfigGet(t, p), json.RawMessage(`null`))
			case "delete-recreate":
				assertSharedOracleJSON(t, systemConfigGet(t, p), json.RawMessage(`["C"]`))
			}
			if name == "absent-insert" {
				assertSharedOracleJSON(t, systemConfigGet(t, p), json.RawMessage(`["A"]`))
				r := callTest(t, a.Handler(), "PUT", "/api/settings/recognition-words", `{"text":"D"}`, cookie, "")
				if r.Code != 400 {
					t.Fatal(r.Code, r.Body)
				}
				if _, e = systemConfigSet(t, p, `null`); e != nil {
					t.Fatal(e)
				} // Source deletes first row only.
				result, e := systemConfigSet(t, p, `null`)
				if e != nil || string(result) != "null" {
					t.Fatal("source same-hot null must not remove the residual row", string(result), e)
				}
				assertSharedOracleJSON(t, systemConfigGet(t, p), json.RawMessage(`null`))
				if e = a.Close(); e != nil {
					t.Fatal(e)
				}
				a, e = New(Options{DataDir: dir, PluginMarketsOverride: &markets})
				if e != nil {
					t.Fatal(e)
				}
				p = a.startOriginalPlugin(context.Background(), "OwnedSystemConfig")
				if p == nil {
					t.Fatal("residual cold worker")
				}
				var cold struct {
					Get json.RawMessage `json:"cold_get"`
				}
				if e = json.Unmarshal(source.Groups["duplicate-delete-cold"].Observations["cold_get"], &cold.Get); e != nil {
					t.Fatal(e)
				}
				assertSharedOracleJSON(t, systemConfigGet(t, p), cold.Get)
				_, rows, e := a.readSharedSystemConfigRows(context.Background(), a.Store.DB)
				if e != nil || len(rows) != 1 || rows[0].ID != 2 {
					t.Fatal(rows, e)
				}
				r = callTest(t, a.Handler(), "PUT", "/api/settings/recognition-words", `{"text":"D"}`, cookie, "")
				if r.Code != 200 {
					t.Fatal(r.Code, r.Body)
				}
				revision, _, e := a.recognitionWords(context.Background())
				if e != nil {
					t.Fatal(e)
				}
				if e = a.saveRecognitionWords(context.Background(), revision, []string{"Native => KeptID"}); e != nil {
					t.Fatal(e)
				}
				_, rows, e = a.readSharedSystemConfigRows(context.Background(), a.Store.DB)
				if e != nil || len(rows) != 1 || rows[0].ID != 2 {
					t.Fatal(rows, e)
				}
			}
		})
	}
	t.Run("dirty-check", func(t *testing.T) {
		a, _, p := sharedSystemConfigFixture(t, sharedSystemConfigAll)
		if _, e := systemConfigSet(t, p, `["A"]`); e != nil {
			t.Fatal(e)
		}
		if _, e := a.Store.DB.Exec(`CREATE TRIGGER owned_mixed_dirty BEFORE UPDATE ON recognition_words BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'owned reject update'); END;`); e != nil {
			t.Fatal(e)
		}
		if _, e := systemConfigSet(t, p, `["B"]`); e == nil {
			t.Fatal("source dirty failure absent")
		}
		result, e := systemConfigSet(t, p, `["A"]`)
		if e != nil || string(result) != "true" {
			t.Fatal(string(result), e)
		}
		assertSystemConfigStored(t, a, []json.RawMessage{json.RawMessage(`["A"]`)})
	})
}

// Real installed RemoteIdentifiers empty-URL producer behavior, with independent
// original callbacks/DAO/WordsMatcher outputs. No extra sync delete producer.
func ownedRemoteReachableInterleavings(t *testing.T) {
	source := sharedRemoteSource(t)
	for _, mode := range []string{"equal", "absent", "existing-empty-ui", "absent-empty-ui"} {
		t.Run("remote-"+mode, func(t *testing.T) {
			groupKey := mode + "-" + mode
			if strings.HasSuffix(mode, "empty-ui") {
				groupKey = "extra-" + groupKey
			}
			group := source[groupKey]
			dir := t.TempDir()
			markets := []string{}
			a, e := New(Options{DataDir: dir, PluginMarketsOverride: &markets})
			if e != nil {
				t.Fatal(e)
			}
			defer func() { a.Close() }()
			cookie := setupTestAdmin(t, a)
			p := installSharedSystemConfigFixture(t, a, cookie, sharedSystemConfigAll)
			initial := sharedRemoteObserved(t, group, "initial")
			if mode == "equal" || mode == "existing-empty-ui" {
				if _, e = systemConfigSet(t, p, string(initial.Get)); e != nil {
					t.Fatal(e)
				}
			}
			assertSharedRemoteSnapshot(t, a, p, initial)
			selected, resume := make(chan struct{}), make(chan struct{})
			var once, releaseOnce sync.Once
			release := func() { releaseOnce.Do(func() { close(resume) }) }
			defer release()
			observe := func() { once.Do(func() { close(selected); <-resume }) }
			raw, _ := json.Marshal(map[string]string{"text": strings.Join(group.UIInput, "\n")})
			request := httptest.NewRequest("PUT", "/api/settings/recognition-words", strings.NewReader(string(raw)))
			request.Header.Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
			request.AddCookie(cookie)
			request = request.WithContext(context.WithValue(request.Context(), ownedConfigSnapshotObserverKey{}, observe))
			done := make(chan *httptest.ResponseRecorder, 1)
			go func() { w := httptest.NewRecorder(); a.Handler().ServeHTTP(w, request); done <- w }()
			select {
			case <-selected:
			case <-time.After(5 * time.Second):
				t.Fatal("real UI SELECT absent")
			}
			sharedRemoteRun(t, p)
			assertSharedRemoteSnapshot(t, a, p, sharedRemoteObserved(t, group, "before_ui_resume"))
			release()
			select {
			case response := <-done:
				if response.Code != 200 {
					t.Fatal(response.Code, response.Body)
				}
			case <-time.After(5 * time.Second):
				t.Fatal("real UI did not resume")
			}
			assertSharedRemoteSnapshot(t, a, p, sharedRemoteObserved(t, group, "after_ui"))
			if strings.HasSuffix(mode, "empty-ui") {
				sharedRemoteRun(t, p)
				assertSharedRemoteSnapshot(t, a, p, sharedRemoteObserved(t, group, "after_next_remote"))
				response := callTest(t, a.Handler(), "PUT", "/api/settings/recognition-words", `{"text":"A => Later"}`, cookie, "")
				_, sourceError := group.Observations["next_ui_error"]
				if (response.Code != 200) != sourceError {
					t.Fatal(response.Code, response.Body)
				}
				assertSharedRemoteSnapshot(t, a, p, sharedRemoteObserved(t, group, "after_next_ui"))
			}
			if mode == "absent" {
				if !strings.Contains(string(group.Observations["next_ui_error"]), "MultipleResultsFound") {
					t.Fatal("source failure evidence absent")
				}
				response := callTest(t, a.Handler(), "PUT", "/api/settings/recognition-words", `{"text":"A => Next"}`, cookie, "")
				if response.Code != 400 || !strings.Contains(response.Body.String(), "SYSTEM_CONFIG_MULTIPLE_RESULTS") {
					t.Fatal(response.Code, response.Body)
				}
			}
			if e = a.Close(); e != nil {
				t.Fatal(e)
			}
			a, e = New(Options{DataDir: dir, PluginMarketsOverride: &markets})
			if e != nil {
				t.Fatal(e)
			}
			p = a.startOriginalPlugin(context.Background(), "OwnedSystemConfig")
			if p == nil {
				t.Fatal("cold actual worker absent")
			}
			coldKey := mode + "-cold"
			if strings.HasSuffix(mode, "empty-ui") {
				coldKey = "extra-" + coldKey
			}
			assertSharedRemoteSnapshot(t, a, p, sharedRemoteObserved(t, source[coldKey], "cold"))
		})
	}
}
